red-text.comment: Darker variant of red for small/normal-weight text on light backgrounds — red alone only clears WCAG AA contrast at large text sizes

red-deep.comment: Darker variant of red for use as a background behind cream text — red alone only gives cream text ~4.0:1 contrast, below the 4.5:1 AA threshold

cream-dark.comment: Slightly darker background, for subtle fills

tape.value: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-mustard) 0%, var(--color-orange) 25%, var(--color-red) 50%, var(--color-red-deep) 75%, var(--color-plum) 100%)
tape.comment: References the CSS custom properties directly (not resolved token values), so it re-colors automatically under any [data-theme] override

red.comment: #D6342A, Dynamicron T-120 box art gradient stripe band 3

red-deep.comment: Same maroon band, reused as background

teal.comment: No teal on the box; aliased to the maroon band, swatch hidden in Storybook
